pages.faq.q1: How can I activate my product warranty?
pages.faq.a1: To activate the warranty, go to the "Warranties" page in your account, then enter the product serial number printed on the package or invoice. Follow the instructions to complete activation.
pages.faq.a2: You can request a return for unused items in their original packaging within 14 days of receipt.
pages.faq.a3: Yes, we provide professional installation services through our network of certified installation centers across various cities.
pages.faq.q4: How do I contact technical support?
pages.faq.a4: You can contact our technical support team via WhatsApp, email, or by calling our customer service number directly.
pages.faq.a5: We accept Mada, Visa, MasterCard, Apple Pay, in addition to installment payment options via Tabby and Tamara.
pages.faq.q6: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
pages.faq.a6: You can update your shipping address before the order is dispatched by contacting customer support directly with your order number.
pages.faq.q7: What is the estimated shipping time?
pages.faq.a7: Estimated shipping and delivery takes 2 to 5 business days for all regions across Saudi Arabia.
pages.faq.cta_title: Didn't find an answer to your question?
pages.faq.cta_subtitle: Our support team is ready to assist you anytime via live chat or email.
